description: The result of /auditor:diff-audit --ci or /auditor:quick-scan --ci, for claude -p --output-format json --json-schema: Claude Code checks the reply against it and returns it as the result's structured_output, which templates/ci/verdict.jq reads. Every field is a fixed word or a number, so a log that prints them shows no finding, count or path (OUTPUT-RULES.md Rule 11d). Only keywords Claude's structured outputs take are used: types, enums, required, items and additionalProperties false.

mode.description: The mode preflight's first line names.

verdict.description: The verdict audit_<n>/findings.json holds: pass or fail.

run.description: The <n> of the run directory audit_<n>; 0 when the run stopped before step 1 made one.

stopped.description: none, or the step the run stopped at: preflight (a refusal), run-directory (rundir.sh refused), arguments, changed-set, denied.

analyzers_run.description: The analyzers that ran, as findings.json names them.

analyzers_not_run.description: The analyzers the run called for that did not run.
